name: swift-instruments
description: Swift Instruments corporate website + enterprise admin panel (monorepo)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @swift/backend" "node scripts/wait-for-api.mjs && npm run dev -w @swift/web" "node scripts/wait-for-api.mjs && npm run dev -w @swift/admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @swift/backend && npm run build -w @swift/web && npm run build -w @swift/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @swift/backend && npm run typecheck -w @swift/web && npm run typecheck -w @swift/admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @swift/web && npm run lint -w @swift/admin
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
